bodyHtml:
🖥️ Scheduled Tune-Ups & Security Hardening · Logan & Surrounds

Preventative Maintenance Logan. Keep It Fast. Keep It Safe. Keep It Running.

Is your computer taking ages to boot, making suspicious whirring noises, or nagging you about updates you don't have time to install? Computer Repairs Logan delivers scheduled tune-ups and security hardening, onsite or remote, so home users, freelancers and small offices stay productive before disaster strikes.

Book A Health Check
✓ Hardware Clean-Out
✓ Security Hardening
✓ Performance Boost
✓ Backup Verification
Why It Matters

Skipped Maintenance Catches Up With Every Computer Eventually.

Just like a car that skips its regular service eventually sputters to a halt, a computer left without routine care slows down, overheats, and invites malware that costs you time and money. A quick tune-up, dusting out the internals, patching security gaps and trimming bloated software, keeps your PC fast, safe and trouble-free.

Our Approach

Prevent Tomorrow's Problem Today.

We run a full tune-up covering hardware, security and performance, then verify your backups actually work, not just that a backup job exists. Available onsite or remote across Logan.

What's Included

What's Included In A Full Tune-Up.

🧹

Hardware Clean-Out

Dust and airflow cleaning, thermal paste renewal, fan-curve tuning for quieter operation, and laptop battery calibration.

🔐

Security Hardening

Windows and third-party patches, a full anti-malware sweep, and an MFA and password-vault check against best-practice guidelines.

⚙️

Performance Boost

Startup and registry declutter, driver, BIOS and firmware updates, an SSD/HDD health scan, and a temp-file and browser-cache purge.

💾

Data Protection Check

Backup image to an external drive or NAS, cloud-sync setup or verification, and a real restore test to prove the backup integrity.

Health Report

Every Visit Ends With A Health Report.

  • Boot-time comparison. Before vs. after, so you can see the difference.
  • Drive health percentage. An early warning before a drive actually fails.
  • Upgrade forecast. Advice on RAM, SSD or battery upgrades worth budgeting for.
  • Patch status & security risk score. A clear picture of where you stand.
Book A Health Check
Popular Add-Ons

Popular Add-Ons.

Extend your tune-up with ongoing coverage or staff training.

📡

Remote Monitoring

Ongoing alerts if a disk starts failing or temperatures spike, so problems get caught before they cause downtime.

💳

Flat-Rate Care Plan

A predictable monthly cost with priority call-outs whenever something comes up.

🧑‍💼

Cyber-Hygiene Training

A short staff session covering phishing emails, malicious attachments and safe password habits for small offices.

Related Services

A Complete Care Package.

Preventative maintenance covers the essentials of every visit, if your PC needs a deeper one-off speed fix, see our dedicated computer tune-up service. If a malware sweep during your visit turns up something serious, our virus and spyware removal service can dig it out properly. Want to make sure your data survives a hardware failure between visits? Set up ongoing backups. And since power surges are one of the quickest ways to undo a good tune-up, ask about UPS and surge protection for your setup.

Frequently Asked Questions

Preventative Maintenance Questions, Answered.

How is preventative maintenance different from a one-off repair?

Preventative maintenance is a scheduled tune-up, dust clean, patch roll-up, backup test, aimed at avoiding failures before they happen. A one-off repair fixes something already broken, often at a higher cost and longer downtime.

How often should I get a tune-up?

Quarterly is ideal for business or heavy-use home PCs, every three months we patch software, refresh malware protection, clean internals and verify backups, keeping performance consistent year-round. Lighter home use can often stretch to twice a year.

Will a tune-up actually make my computer faster?

A registry clean alone rarely makes a big difference on its own. We combine safe registry pruning with startup-item auditing, drive health checks and dust/thermal cleaning for a noticeable, lasting speed boost.

Do you offer remote maintenance?

Yes, software-only tasks like patches, malware sweeps and driver updates can be handled over secure remote support. Hardware cleaning and thermal paste work still requires an onsite visit.

Do you verify that my backups actually work?

Yes, we run a real restore test rather than just checking that a backup job exists, so you know your files will actually come back if you ever need them.

Do I get anything in writing after the visit?

Yes, every session ends with a health report covering what was done, key health metrics, upgrade advice, and a recommended date for your next service.
